NewsArticle.Title: Guild: Private Tablet
NewsArticle.Content:
A motley or guild with 16 or more members will have a guild letters tablet made for the guild. The guild must be in Temuairan taste, according to mundanes. The guild leader must write the mundanes when membership is 16 or greater ((Submit event at: [www.darkages.com/community/news/index.html](http://www.darkages.com/community/news/index.html))).
The tablet is viewable and writable anywhere that mail is available by a guild member. Only the motley or guild leader may administer the tablet.
Private Tablets available immediately:
- Aingeal Aire
- Runic Terra
- Tuatha de Deo
View [all features screenshots.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
